Name: Fire Brew
Description: Ash on the tongue. Whoever drinks it learns to burn.
Notes: YOUR EXAMPLE. AN ELEMENTAL BEER (Anthony
column17: 9 Oct): a plain (Normal) player who was already at 60% (the Elemental level in DrunkLevels.csv) BEFORE he drinks it becomes a Rauhnacht-Feuergeist - class
column18: Fire and both abilities all at once. Below that it only fills his meter. Already elemental = refused: a Glass of Water first. Feeds goals_with_brew_fire.

Name: Water Brew
Description: Cold and deep. Whoever drinks it hears the river.
Notes: The water one: a plain player at 60% beforehand becomes a Lorelei
column18: 9 Oct). Same rules as the Fire Brew. Needs the Water Craft talent.

Name: Keeper's Tonic
Description: Thick, bitter, and it makes you very hard to move.
Notes: No Becomes and no For Class - anyone may drink it, nobody changes class, they just gain a defend ability. Permanent is blank so it always wears off.

Name: Lorelei Team Spirit
Description: Everyone drinks from the same cup. Whatever was in it, they are one side now.
Notes: THE TEAM SPIRIT, forged in the class tree when all three Lorelei nodes hold a Star. Note what it is: AN ORDINARY ROW OF THIS FILE. The tree unlocks the name in Requires and does nothing else, so you can rewrite the drink completely - the element, both abilities, the price, whether it is permanent - without touching a line of code.

Name: Feuergeister Team Spirit
Description: Ash in the cup and ash on the tongue. Nobody flinches.
Notes: The same for the other class. Its Requires is the name the tree unlocks - spelled exactly as ClassTree.spirit_unlock() builds it: the words Team Spirit and then the class name.

Name: Rhine Water Lager
Description: Cold from the river. Three of these and he hears her singing.
Notes: A TURNING BREW (round X). ROUND AN (Anthony, 9 Oct): with the Elemental level in DrunkLevels.csv ONE pour does it, if he was at 60% before it - the Drinks number only counts if you take the word turns off every level. Drinks 3: three pours on a plain card and he becomes a Lorelei at his own tier and power, keeping his name. On the third the Pub asks which card he becomes - one per set. A different element in between starts the count again.

Name: Rauhnacht Smoke Beer
Description: Smoked over the twelve nights. Three, and something answers.
Notes: Turning brew - fire. Same rules as turn_water.

Name: Miner's Dunkel
Description: Black as the seam and twice as heavy.
Notes: Turning brew - earth. Same rules as turn_water.

Name: Unken Weisse
Description: Cloudy, cold, and it croaks a little.
Notes: Turning brew - air. Same rules as turn_water.

Name: Helles
Description: A clean, golden Mass. Nobody becomes anybody, they just start to sing.
Notes: ROUND AN - THE DRUNK METER. INSPIRATION is how much of the meter (DrunkLevels.csv) one of these fills, in %. Blank = 0. A row with no Becomes and no abilities is a PLAIN BEER: it only fills the meter, and it is the only thing a sober player can be given. Free, so a team can always start drinking. DRAFT.

Name: Glass of Water
Description: Cold, clear, and nobody cheers. He comes back to himself.
Notes: ROUND AN - WATER (Anthony, 9 Oct: if they want to switch from Elemental to another, give them water, to reduce their drunkenness to get below 60% to transform them back to normal). INSPIRATION BELOW 0 SOBERS HIM: -30 takes 30% off the meter. If that leaves an elemental player below the Elemental level (DrunkLevels.csv turns) he turns back to plain - the class, element and abilities all go - and can drink a different elemental beer once he is back up to 60%. NOT FREE AND NOT AT THE PUB (Anthony, 9 Oct): Pool water keeps it off the Pub list; the only way to get it is the Bottle of Water (Items.csv water_bottle), which only the Traveling Merchant sells (Shop.csv trade_water), at a price that moves with his mood. Used on a player during a match like any bottle. DRAFT number.

Name: Festbier
Description: Stronger than it looks. Two of these and the Tuba sounds like the Rhine.
Notes: A stronger plain beer, made from your own Brewery materials. DRAFT.

Name: Plain Beer
Description: Hits the back of the net. Or yours.
Notes: ROUND AN - PLAIN BEER (Anthony, 8 Oct: plain beer gives random abilities that have one positive and then the opposite being negative). POOL = plain: these rows are never poured at the Pub; a basic beer from the bag (Items.csv small_bottle, large_bottle, keg: Use brew:pool:plain) picks ONE of them at random, among the rows whose Requires pass. Every row: a good ATTACK side and its opposite, bad, DEFEND side. This one is the tutorial's: 1 off the enemy keeper when he attacks, 1 off your own when he defends. It is the only one with a blank Requires, so it is the only one in the tutorial (the others need !flag:in_tutorial). POOL can name several pools, plain|keg: the keg (Kleiner Faß) draws from pool keg, so the tutorial can give it its own row (Pool keg, Requires flag:in_tutorial) while the bottles keep this one. keg_goalie is this pair for the keg outside the tutorial. Add a row to add a pair.

Name: Plain Beer
Description: Brave going forward, wobbly at the back.
Notes: Plain beer pair: +1 power when he attacks, -1 when he defends.

Name: Plain Beer
Description: A round for your keeper. And one for theirs.
Notes: Plain beer pair: 1 stamina back to your keeper when he attacks, 1 back to theirs when he defends.

Name: Plain Beer
Description: Hits the back of the net. Or yours.
Notes: The goalie pair for the Kleiner Faß outside the tutorial (in the tutorial the keg is the Tutorial thread's kleiner_fass row, Pool keg).

Name: Kleiner Faß
Description: A little barrel. Down it in one, spill half.
Notes: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL (Anthony, 8 Oct): the Kleiner Faß (Items.csv keg, Use brew:pool:keg) the Head Coach hands a 0 Power player in cycle 2. Anyone may drink it; no class change. Drunk in a match it takes hold at once (Tuning.csv match_drink_takes_hold_at) and lasts the cycle (match_drink_lasts_cycle). POOL keg + REQUIRES flag:in_tutorial: in the tutorial this is the only keg row whose Requires pass, so the keg always gives it; outside the tutorial the keg is a plain beer gamble again.

Name: Anstoß Helles
Description: The kick-off beer. Pass it on.
Notes: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL COMBO BEERS (Anthony, 8 Oct): one good side and one bad side. POOL is its own ID, so it is never poured at the Pub; Items.csv anstoss_helles (Use brew:pool:anstoss_helles) is the bottle. The tutorial gives three in cycle 2 round 3 (MatchTalk.csv tut_combo).

Name: Doppelpass Weiße

Notes: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL COMBO BEERS (Anthony, 8 Oct): one good side and one bad side. POOL is its own ID, so it is never poured at the Pub; Items.csv doppelpass_weisse (Use brew:pool:doppelpass_weisse) is the bottle. The tutorial gives three in cycle 2 round 3 (MatchTalk.csv tut_combo).
